transparency.securityBody: Generated code is untrusted and executes inside an isolated iframe with sandbox="allow-scripts allow-pointer-lock" and no allow-same-origin. Pointer lock only captures the mouse for 3D games after your gesture; the code still gets zero cookie access and zero credential leakage.

platform.title: Gamedev.pl coding agent
platform.detail: We assign a coding agent and you watch progress here.

note.outage: Down for a bit — try again shortly.

detail.coming_soon: The Gamedev.pl coding agent hasn't launched in this environment yet. Use your own coding agent instead.
detail.outage: The Gamedev.pl coding agent is temporarily unavailable. Use your own coding agent, or try again shortly.
detail.global_limit: The Gamedev.pl coding agent has reached today's shared build limit. Use your own coding agent, or try again tomorrow.
detail.user_limit: You've reached your daily limit for the Gamedev.pl coding agent. Use your own coding agent, or try again tomorrow.

self.title: My own coding agent
self.detail: You connect Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, or another agent.

badge.modalLede: This applies to the next round. You can change again when no agent is working.

connect.title: Connect your coding agent
connect.lead: This round waits for your agent. Add gamedev.pl in one click when you can, or paste the config, then the build prompt.
connect.loadError: We couldn't load the connect steps right now. Refresh in a moment.
connect.waiting: Waiting for your agent to check in…

installLinks.hint: One click adds the gamedev.pl server URL only — sign in or paste your Authorization header afterwards. No secret rides in the link.

step1.title: Add gamedev.pl to your agent
step1.configHint: Or paste this into your agent's MCP server settings. The Authorization line is masked here — Copy puts the real header on your clipboard.
step1.skip: Already added it for another game? Skip this
step1.skipped: Skipped — using the install you already have.

step2.title: Tell your agent what to build
step2.sameConnection: Your gamedev.pl connection stays in your agent config — this prompt carries only the game slug, never a secret.
step2.sameKeyAsBefore: Same key as before — nothing new to copy unless you rotated it.
step2.expiry: This key works for this game and expires {{when}}.

oauth.title: Sign in from your agent
oauth.hint: Or copy this MCP URL into any other agent, then sign in when it asks. Pass the game slug from the prompt below when you start. If Cursor shows Unauthorized without opening a browser, open the authorize URL from Output → MCP logs (known Cursor bug), or use Paste header.

switchBuilder.hint: Prefer not to connect your own agent? Your game will stay safe and Gamedev.pl can continue this round instead.
switchBuilder.confirm: Stop waiting for your agent and start Gamedev.pl's coding agent?
switchBuilder.pending: Waiting for the current agent to acknowledge the stop request…
switchBuilder.pendingStale: This is taking longer than usual — the agent hasn't acknowledged the stop request yet.
switchBuilder.error: We couldn't switch agents right now. Try again in a moment.
switchBuilder.activeConfirm: Stop your agent and let Gamedev.pl continue this game? Work already delivered will stay with it.
switchBuilder.activeSelfConfirm: Stop Gamedev.pl's agent and continue with your agent? Work already delivered will stay with this game.

rotate.confirm: Rotating stops any agent still using the old key. Continue?
rotate.error: We couldn't rotate the key right now. Try again in a moment.

resume.title: Continue with your agent
resume.lead: Your agent went quiet. Paste this prompt into the same session — or start a new one with your existing gamedev.pl connection.
resume.kickoffHint: This prompt carries only the game slug. Your MCP connection stays in the agent config.
resume.waiting: Waiting for your agent to check in again…

workspaceCheckout.title: Work on this game in your own IDE
workspaceCheckout.hint: Get a working copy — this game's sources, a setup script and a README, ready for your own editor and your own Git repo. The game stays here: when you're done, your agent delivers the changes back and they go through the usual round, gate and review before anything is published.
workspaceCheckout.done: Your working copy is on its way to your downloads.

errors.signedOut: You're signed out. Sign in again to get a working copy.
errors.notFound: We couldn't find this game on your shelf.
errors.notDelivered: This game has no delivered version yet — let the first build finish, then check it out.
errors.unavailable: Working copies are temporarily unavailable. Try again a little later.
errors.failed: We couldn't put your working copy together. Try again in a moment.

oauthClients.title: Connected coding agents
oauthClients.hint: Agents authorized to access your games through MCP. Disconnecting one removes its access immediately.

oauthClients.revokeError: We couldn't disconnect that client. Try again in a moment.
oauthClients.empty: No coding agents are connected to your account.
oauthClients.confirm: Disconnect {{client}}? It will lose access immediately and must be approved again to reconnect.

creatorKey.title: Coding-agent key
creatorKey.hint: Use this header with coding agents that cannot sign in through a browser. It lets them work on any of your games.

creatorKey.revoked: Your coding-agent key was revoked. Create a new one when you are ready to reconnect.
creatorKey.mintError: We couldn't create a key right now. Try again in a moment.

rotate.confirm: Create a replacement key? Every agent using the current key will lose access immediately, and you will need to copy the new header into each one.

creatorKey.rotateError: We couldn't rotate the key right now. Try again in a moment.

revoke.confirm: Revoke this key? Every agent using it will lose access immediately. You can create a new key later.

creatorKey.revokeError: We couldn't revoke the key right now. Try again in a moment.

remix.title: Remix
remix.inputLabel: Describe a change to this game
remix.needsCode: That one didn't land. Try saying it a different way.
remix.couldNotBuild: That didn't work out. Try saying it a different way.
remix.tooBig: That's too big for now — try something smaller.
remix.quota: You've made a lot of changes — take a break and try later.
remix.unavailable: Couldn't do that right now — the game still plays.
remix.sharedWithoutCode: Link copied — it carries your settings, not the code change.
remix.shareFailed: Couldn't make a link for that.
remix.keepOfferBody: You've shaped this a few times. Save it to your Studio — nothing goes live until you publish.
remix.saveQuota: You've created a lot today — try again tomorrow.
remix.saveNoSources: This game can't be saved to Studio yet.
remix.saveNoChanges: Change something first — then you can keep it.
remix.conceptSeed: A game like {{slug}}, but my own version
remix.signInTitle: Sign in to remix this game
remix.signInSubtitle: Remixing is tied to your account while we're in closed beta.
remix.wallSubtitle: Your request is saved — it runs the moment you're in.
remix.tookTooLong: That took too long — here's your game back, unchanged.
remix.napping: Editing is napping right now — the game still plays.
remix.notHere: This game can't be remixed yet — but it still plays.
remix.buildingWait: This takes a moment. The game comes back on its own.
remix.editorOffer: That's a map change — the level editor can do it.
remix.sharedWithoutContent: Link copied — it carries your settings; painted maps stay in this remix.
remix.undone: Put back the way it was.
remix.brokeIt: That change stopped the game working. Put it back?
